# Vendored: ackermann_msgs 2.0.2

Source: https://github.com/ros-drivers/ackermann_msgs, tag 2.0.2, commit df2fe51eb04e8bd3c0ba4f8a6ded8aea3815b660.
Licence: BSD (as declared in package.xml). Unmodified.

Why vendored: so the Docker image builds identically with no access to packages.ros.org. On a normal machine,
`sudo apt install ros-humble-ackermann-msgs` gives the same message definitions.
